rubrics.justification: Describes an expanded/near-expanded blastocyst with thinned zona, visible ICM, and reasonably cellular TE, and appropriately notes possible collapse/re-expansion and limits of single-plane imaging. Slight hedge versus the provided 3AA grade prevents a perfect score.
Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian reserve, oocyte yield, male factor diagnosis, sperm motility concerns, BMI, endometrial thickness, first-cycle status, and lifestyle factors with embryo prognosis.

Reasoning is logical and internally consistent, especially around morphology versus euploidy uncertainty. Minor overreach includes attributing former smoking and sedentary lifestyle as meaningful implantation modifiers without strong case-specific evidence.

Generally consistent with Gardner grading interpretation, single embryo transfer principles, and standard IVF counseling. Small deviations include somewhat speculative emphasis on PGT-A and lifestyle factors, but no major guideline conflicts.

Provides practical recommendations for proceeding with transfer, luteal support, lifestyle, and contingency planning after failure. Useful and specific, though some suggestions remain general rather than tightly protocol-driven.
